evidence.mission_note: A lifted GX470 on all-terrains with a roof basket clearly adds body-on-frame capability the RX 350 does not supply, which fits the utility_capability branch, though the build exceeds the light-camping need and should not command a premium. At nearly 200k miles it is acceptable as a Lexus only if the claimed major service is documented.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a black-over-grey 2007 GX470 (the seller corrects the form's 2008) at 198,500 claimed miles with a visible Eibach lift, 33-inch BFGoodrich all-terrains on Method wheels, and a roof basket. The seller gives a mileage-stamped work list, notably timing belt, water pump and radiator at 179k plus broad front-end renewal, but no dates, receipts, VIN, title status or owner count, so all of it is claimed only. Photos show good paint, a tidy interior with moderate rear-bench wear, matching deep-tread tires and oxidized headlights; the underside, engine bay and running dash were not examined here. The modified suspension raises open questions about rear air suspension disposition, AVS faults and lift install quality. 'No major accidents' is a hedged statement. At $14,000 the car sits at the fair-value mid of $13,896, and seven weeks on market with a relist at an unchanged price indicates possible negotiating room.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, title status, the dated 179k timing-belt invoice, rear air suspension status, and agreement to a PPI at an independent shop near Corona.
